name: iSimcha Dev Shell
description: Installs Nushell, Starship and the shared CLI tool set, and lays down the iSimcha Nushell and Starship configuration.

ouchVersion.description: Version of ouch, the decompression tool used to unpack the other CLI tools.

installPackages.description: Install the CLI tools listed in packages.json (just, ripgrep, fd, bun, starship and the rest).

installConfig.description: Lay down the Nushell and Starship configuration in the workspace .cache directory on container create.
